Macquarie Asset Management (MAM) has announced the launch of its dedicated education program for wealth advisers focused on private infrastructure to deepen their understanding of the asset class and its role in client portfolios. The program’s first installment, “Inside Infrastructure: Charting the Asset Class,” is a research-led chartbook that analyzes proprietary data from Macquarie’s decades of infrastructure investing experience.

The program brings together educational content, proprietary research and perspectives from Macquarie Asset Management’s infrastructure specialists in a platform tailored for the wealth market. The launch of this educational program comes as more qualified individual investors seek direct exposure to institutional-grade infrastructure investment opportunities and wealth advisers increasingly need resources to evaluate the asset class.
